notes.title: This game has expanded supported language to 18.
notes.content:
This game has added support for six more languages, expanding supported languages to 18. Additionally, more languages are planned to be supported in the future. The fully supported languages now include: English, German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, French, Dutch, Danish, Polish, Japanese, Norwegian (Bokmål), Finnish, Thai, Korean, Spanish, Czech, Indonesian, and Kazakh.  

Languages planned for future support include: Serbian, Turkish, Portuguese, Bulgarian, Italian, Hungarian, Ukrainian, Swedish, Romanian, Belarusian, Slovak, Estonian, Greek, Vietnamese, Malay, Hindi, Hebrew, Slovenian, Latvian, Arabic, Urdu, Punjabi, Tamil, Bengali, Georgian, Telugu, Swahili, Burmese, and more.  

Thank you to all players for purchasing this game and previous games from our studio - Alright Peaches Studio. We hope you continue to support us!
